definitions.usage: DSH TokenUsage input is uncached; cacheRead/cacheWrite disjoint input; reasoning separate and not added to total
definitions.promptInput: input+cacheRead+cacheWrite when all known; otherwise total-output only if nonnegative and consistent with known input counters; missing raw fields remain null
definitions.aggregation: own rows only; inherited/unknown-seeded ownership retained in ledger but excluded
definitions.missing: null; observedSum never claims an exact grand total when missingRequests>0
definitions.routing: historical association; protocol unknown unless explicitly persisted; no wire evidence
definitions.migration: preserve distinct sequences within each journal; merge only same-sequence local copies; cross-version base-identity matching reserves same-sequence pairs then counters/route then ordinal; higher version wins conflicts and lower version fills null
definitions.usageSource: explicit event usage preferred; otherwise last timed chunk {type:chunk,chunk:{type:usage,usage}} snapshot; cumulative snapshots are never summed

snapshot.description: Each compressed file is a read-only byte snapshot between startedAt and completedAt; appends after its read do not alter captured SHA or ledger
